notes.title: Hyper Gunsport on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Whilst Hyper Gunsport is not yet Steam Deck verified, we are happy to announce that the game has full support for Steam Deck! Hyper Gunsport has a fully native SteamOS/Linux version that runs at a locked 60fps on Steam Deck and plays great with the in-built controls. We also have full support for Steam Cloud saves, including Dynamic Cloud Sync! This means you can switch from Steam Deck to any PC device (and back!) without closing the game on your Deck and never lose progress!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621788/c92ecf7ee9014fa5c62564f8cb2d02af4ba99c7f.png


Native Linux support!
1280x800 screen support!
60 fps!
Steam Cloud Save with Dynamic Sync support. 


EDIT - Jan 3rd 2023
Hyper Gunsport is now verified as Steam Deck compatible!
